ambient_events: A hound is done, and gets up, and the next one comes and sits without being called.
Twelve heads turn at the same moment toward the gate, and then turn back.
A collar is taken off its peg, checked, oiled, and hung back up.
description: A run of wire and shade cloth with a dozen hounds in it, long-legged and scarred and heavy in the shoulder. They come up to the wire to look at you, all of them at once and in silence, which is much worse than barking.
name: The Houndyard
